g.text: ADR-0012 gate, G2 metrics. A candidate must beat both UP and V03-full lines (G2b: exceed them)

text.style: font-size: 6.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #333333

g.text: Candidate 1 was scored under the original rules (G2a emission layer, G2e target 0.512), so its G2a and G2e are not plotted. G2b exists only for UP, V03-full, 1, 2, 6 (R1-dev reads); candidate 6 G2b is the dev value. Candidates 3-6b are train-side only.
